title: WWS SteamWhistle.ogg (Steam Whistle)
author: Work With Sounds / Konrad Gutkowski; sound recordists Konrad Gutkowski, Julian Blaschke
subject: Steam whistle (bell type) of Prussian P 8 passenger locomotive 38 2267, built 1918 by Berliner Maschinenbau AG; Bochum railway museum
attribution: Steam whistle of P 8 38 2267 by Work With Sounds / Konrad Gutkowski, Julian Blaschke, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
processing: None: the original file, renamed. VehicleHorn plays a cut of it (STEAM_WHISTLE_START / STEAM_WHISTLE_LENGTH) with a 120 ms runtime fade-out.
limitations: Not auditioned by the agent. The cut offsets are placeholders until tuned by ear. A museum recording, not one of the game's narrow-gauge locomotives.
